reference.name: csem_paper_kl_f8_lwd
reference.basis: Zhou et al., TGRS 2026, DOI:10.1109/TGRS.2026.3661733, equations (12)-(13)
reference.status: CSEM paper method adapted to LWD; unpublished implementation details are explicit assumptions.
assumptions: Paper II-B: pretrained KL-f8, mean RGB-to-gray weights, pixel L2 + frozen image-feature L2 + KL; whole VAE fine-tuned.
Original CompVis KL-f8 OpenImages checkpoint is selected; identity with the authors private initialization is not established.
Elementwise pixel MSE; ImageNet-normalized AlexNet ReLU [1,4,7,9,11] feature MSE averaged across layers; KL summed per sample then batch mean.
feature_weight=1, kl_weight=1e-5, SGD lr=1e-4 momentum=0.9 weight_decay=5e-4 and 10 epochs are LWD starting settings, not recovered CSEM final hyperparameters.
No LPIPS calibration, TV/gradient loss, discriminator, EMA or weight schedule in this training route.
LWD retains global 48x120 one-inch grid and manifest train/val splits; best model selected by validation log10rho RMSE.
